title: StatelessCalculationRequest
description: Wire contract for the JSON body POSTed to the tax-calc-engine's stateless calculation endpoint (POST /api/calculate). C46-COMPAT: authored to back the compatibility-registry `engineImplementation.requestSchemaHash` field (repos/rule-packs/annual/uk-sa/2025-26/1.0.0/compatibility-manifests.json, schema repos/rule-packs/src/annual-definitions.ts:75-106). Derived and cross-verified 2026-08-08 from firstlot-suite src/lib/filing/calculation.ts (`StatelessCalculationRequest`, `ENGINE_INPUT_NAMES`, `buildStatelessCalculationRequest`) against tax-calc-engine FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Api/Models/StatelessCalculationRequest.cs, FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Api/Controllers/StatelessCalculationController.cs (`RequiredInputNames`), and FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Core/Interfaces/IIncomeTaxCalculator.cs (`IncomeTaxInputs`) — the two sides matched with no divergence found. Not yet referenced by the compatibility registry; that edit and ratification are a separate, later step.

rateJurisdiction.description: Closed vocabulary per TS `StatelessCalculationRequest['rateJurisdiction']` and the engine's `TaxpayerRateJurisdictions.TryParse` (see FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Api/Models/IncomeTaxRequest.cs doc comment). 'scottish' is accepted on the request but the engine currently fails closed with HTTP 422 JURISDICTION_UNSUPPORTED rather than returning a result for it.

rulesetVersion.description: Exact-match pinned ruleset label (e.g. 'tax-calc-engine/2025-26@0.9.0'). The engine compares this for exact string equality against its installed governed ruleset and never applies a default or latest fallback.

formInputs.description: Exactly the 12 numeric engine inputs. TS `EngineFormInputs = Record<typeof ENGINE_INPUT_NAMES[number], number>` is constructed with exactly this key set (calculation.ts buildEngineFormInputs); the engine's StatelessCalculationController.RequiredInputNames requires the identical 12 names to be present as JSON numbers before deserializing into IncomeTaxInputs.

taxedUkInterestNetGbp.description: NET taxed UK interest (SA100 INC1), grossed x100/80 into savings income and credited at 20% engine-side (MTR c2.14 / c11.27). Required on the wire as of engine 0.9.0.
